name: expansion-e3b
description: Expansion wave E3B audit — Tier-2/tail rows 23,24,27,30: media-lowboy (tv-console front=lowboy: flanking drawer bays + central open shelf niche + rear cable notch), storage-bench (plain piped lid on legs / tufted lid / plinth base), bay-daybed (window daybed: storage base + seat cushion + side bolsters + back cushions, narrow & wide), ceiling-light pendant-cluster (3–5 pendants at staggered drops from one canopy — cords MUST connect canopy→shade — dome/globe/cone + a single-pendant regression). Staged on open ground BESIDE the flat in the whole-flat ORBIT dollhouse camera whose ~3/4 elevation reveals float/attachment; a NIGHT pass for the cluster glow. showCeilingFixtures on so the ceiling lights render.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); s.setShowCeilingFixtures?.(true); s.exitRoomEditor?.(); s.setCameraMode?.('orbit'); })()

steps.name: place-grid
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['tv-console',{}], ['tv-console',{front:'lowboy'}], ['storage-bench',{}], ['storage-bench',{style:'tufted'}], ['storage-bench',{base:'plinth'}], ['bay-daybed',{}], ['bay-daybed',{width:2.0}], ['ceiling-light',{arrangement:'cluster'}], ['ceiling-light',{arrangement:'cluster',count:5,shade:'globe'}], ['ceiling-light',{arrangement:'cluster',count:3,shade:'cone'}], ['ceiling-light',{}] ]; const cols = 4; const dx = 2.4, dz = 2.6, x0 = 1.0, z0 = -6.5; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = x0 + c * dx, z = z0 + r * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: 0, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-lowboy-drawers-reg
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['tv-console:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.35, p[1]], radius: 1.2 }); })()

steps.name: go-night
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setManualHour?.(21); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); })()
